response.hypothesis: A dollar-neutral, monthly-rebalanced cross-sectional equity portfolio combining medium-term momentum (12-1 and 6-1), one-month reversal, and a low-volatility tilt can harvest persistent style premia while remaining robust to turnover and single-name concentration. The strategy ranks only currently tradable, liquid, eligible names, goes long the top 25 composite scores and short the bottom 25, with equal weights per side capped below the 2% single-name limit and gross exposure below 100%.
